remaining_unproven: Final Site build and deployment are not certified by this report.
No real iPhone/iPad or browser run; no 50 GB mixed batch or 100 GB account/storage capacity test.
Active workers do not survive destroyed browser processes; multipart transfer resumes are not durable byte-level recovery across browser/device loss.
Several parsers and result serializers require whole buffers; no arbitrary app file cap does not imply unbounded browser memory.
No live MCP connector installation, production multi-account browser authorization test, penetration test, or production quota/throughput certification.
verdict: All requested bounded checks passed and the portable source mirror is complete relative to the current Site allowlist. Prior feature evidence remains explicitly qualified; deployment, device QA and extreme-capacity tests remain separate gates.
